summary: Dedicated region failover not engaging; elevated timeouts during zonal GPU outage
description:
Deployment mode: Dedicated.

Issue summary:
During a zonal GPU outage in us-east-az2, customer saw request timeouts rather than traffic shifting to their configured secondary region (us-central). Dedicated routing policy indicates failover enabled.

Impact:
- Timeout rate peaked at ~18% for 27 minutes
- p95 latency > 20s during backlog

Investigation notes:
- Scheduler marked nodes 'NotReady' but routing layer still considered region 'healthy' due to stale health signal
- Failover threshold uses region-level error budget but did not account for queueing timeouts.
comments: 2026-02-14 21:06 UTC (Naomi Feldman): Customer escalation via #support. Confirmed timeouts and no visible failover in traces.
2026-02-14 21:20 UTC (Dev Patel): Found: regional health metric only counts 5xx; timeouts surfaced as client-side cancel after 30s and not included.
2026-02-14 21:45 UTC (Dev Patel): Manual action: forced failover to us-central for customer endpoint. Timeout rate dropped immediately.
2026-02-15 02:30 UTC (Dev Patel): PR 9310 to include queue depth + deadline-exceeded in failover health evaluation.
2026-02-16 11:00 UTC (Naomi Feldman): Customer confirmed incident resolved; requested RCA + assurance failover triggers on timeouts.
2026-02-16 17:10 UTC (Dev Patel): Fix deployed; added alert when failover policy configured but health stays green during backlog.
resolution: Forced temporary failover to secondary region and patched health evaluation to account for deadline-exceeded/queueing timeouts. Deployed routing fix and validated with replay.
workaround: Support can force failover at endpoint level during regional degradation; advise customers to configure secondary region for Dedicated.
root_cause: Dedicated failover health signal ignored timeouts (treated as client cancels), so region stayed 'healthy' despite scheduler backlog from zonal GPU outage.
follow_ups: Add synthetic canary that validates failover on elevated queue
Update customer docs on Dedicated failover semantics
Review all health gates for missing timeout signals
